verified: TSMC said at its 2026 Europe OIP Ecosystem Workshop that A14 PDK 0.9 is ready for design-in and that Cadence and Synopsys completed full design-flow certification on an Arm Cortex-A725 core; the claimed 14% speed, 23% power, 50% energy-efficiency, 22% transistor-density and 23% logic-density gains are TSMC's own comparisons against N2P.
unconfirmed: independent measurements of those gains, actual customer tapeout results or yields, A14 pricing, and whether the H2 2027 risk-production and H2 2028 mass-production schedules hold.

verified: Tom's Hardware 报道，TSMC 在 2026 欧洲 OIP 生态研讨会上宣布 A14 的 0.9 版 PDK 与设计生态可供设计导入，Cadence 与 Synopsys 已在 Arm Cortex-A725 上完成全流程认证，并给出 2027 年下半年风险生产、2028 年下半年量产的日程。
unconfirmed: 14% 性能提升、23% 功耗下降、50% 能效提升等数字均为 TSMC 对 N2P 的对比承诺，尚无独立测量或量产芯片数据；Siemens EDA 的晶体管级 EM/IR 认证仍在进行，目标 2026 年第四季度，其认证覆盖也少于另外两家。

titles.en: TSMC's A14 1.4nm-class node ready for design with PDK 0.9
titles.zh: 台积电 A14 的 0.9 版 PDK 可供设计导入
